task.description: Implement ADP-08 in backend code and migrations according to src/design/adp-08-service-task-catalog-reference.md. Extend SERVICE_TASK configuration and execution path to support service_id catalog references while preserving legacy url behavior from EXT-01. Enforce precedence when both service_id and url are present: service_id takes precedence, url ignored, warning logged. Apply capability check service:call:<service_id> for service_id path and ensure deterministic behavior for missing/invalid catalog entries. Add or update tests to cover legacy compatibility, new service_id routing, precedence warning, and capability enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: Legacy SERVICE_TASK definitions using url execute unchanged
SERVICE_TASK definitions using service_id execute via catalog lookup with capability enforcement
When both service_id and url are present, service_id path is used and warning is logged
Backend validations pass: zig build, zig build test, zig build migrate
No SQL interpolation or secret leakage; typed errors and existing security constraints preserved

result.summary: Implemented ADP-08 backend service-task catalog routing: added service_id parsing and precedence over url with warnings, capability enforcement for service:call:<service_id>, deterministic missing-catalog handling, and aligned graph/runtime behavior with unit and integration coverage.
